headline: Amazon to fund new nuclear plant at former Indiana coal site
summary: Amazon signed a deal with X-energy, and AEP according to one report, to fund a nuclear power facility replacing a defunct coal plant in Indiana, expected to generate up to 960 megawatts, or nearly a gigawatt. One report specifies 12 small reactors, while another notes X-energy has yet to build a working reactor.

claims.statement: Amazon signed a deal with X-energy to fund a new nuclear facility at the site of a former coal plant in Indiana.

sources.quote: Amazon has signed an agreement with X-energy and American Electric Power (AEP) to fund the building of a new nuclear energy facility in Indiana.
Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid.
